import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from scipy.stats import chi2_contingency

def task_func(df1, df2, column1="feature1", column2="feature2"):
    """
    Merge two dataframes on 'id', perform a chi-square independence test on
    the specified columns, and plot a heatmap of the contingency table.

    Parameters
    ----------
    df1, df2 : pandas.DataFrame
        Input dataframes containing an 'id' column and the target feature columns.
    column1, column2 : str
        Names of the columns to use for the contingency table.

    Returns
    -------
    tuple
        (p, heatmap)
        p : float
            p-value from the chi-squared test.
        heatmap : matplotlib.axes.Axes
            Axes object containing the seaborn heatmap.
    """
    merged_df = pd.merge(df1, df2, on="id", how="inner", suffixes=("_df1", "_df2"))

    if column1 not in merged_df.columns or column2 not in merged_df.columns:
        raise KeyError(
            f"Columns '{column1}' and/or '{column2}' not found after merging."
        )

    contingency_table = pd.crosstab(merged_df[column1], merged_df[column2])

    chi2, p, dof, expected = chi2_contingency(contingency_table)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    sns.heatmap(contingency_table, annot=True, fmt="d", cmap="YlGnBu", ax=ax)
    ax.set_xlabel(column2)
    ax.set_ylabel(column1)
    ax.set_title("Contingency Table Heatmap")

    return p, ax
